description: This file defines the MediaEmbed class, a Drupal plugin filter that processes custom <drupal-media> tags to embed media entities within content. It includes methods for rendering media, handling attributes, and managing dependencies.

classes.name: MediaEmbed
classes.description: A Drupal plugin filter class that processes <drupal-media> tags to embed media entities, with methods for rendering, attribute handling, dependency management, and contextual link control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as entity repository, type manager, display repository, renderer, and logger.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds a configuration form for default view mode, media types, and view modes.

methods.name: validateOptions
methods.description: Validates and filters selected options in the form.

methods.name: renderMedia
methods.description: Creates a render array for a media entity in a specified view mode and language.

methods.name: renderMissingMediaIndicator
methods.description: Returns a render array indicating missing media source.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes input text, finds <drupal-media> tags, loads media entities by UUID, and replaces tags with rendered media or error indicators.

methods.name: tips
methods.description: Provides user guidance on embedding media via <drupal-media> tags.

methods.name: renderIntoDomNode
methods.description: Renders a build array into a DOM node, updating the filter result with metadata.

methods.name: replaceNodeContent
methods.description: Replaces the content of a DOMNode with new HTML or text.

methods.name: disableContextualLinks
methods.description: Removes contextual links from the render array for embedded media.

methods.name: applyPerEmbedMediaOverrides
methods.description: Overrides media entity attributes based on HTML tag attributes, such as alt and title.

methods.name: getMediaImageSourceField
methods.description: Retrieves the image source field name from a media entity if applicable.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of static callback methods for trusted execution.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies based on view modes.

methods.name: onCollectionDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, updating settings if related view modes are deleted.
